changelog:
Introduce multi-OS build matrix and a separate release job that aggregates artifacts, computes SHA-256 checksums, and generates detailed release_notes.md. Update CI to rename and upload per-platform artifacts and download them in the release step; extract version from tag and publish GitHub releases with all assets. Change update.json to point to the Setup installer.

Packaging/desktop: improve Packager platform detection and support Linux outputs; add robust electron-builder artifact discovery. electron/main.js: add downloadFile and startAutoUpdate (progress UI, automatic installer launch), expand update dialog options and better error/status handling. electron/package.json: add Linux targets and explicit artifact naming for Setup/Portable installers.

App fixes: routes/info.py trims duplicate filename markers and improves platform labeling by inferring from extractor or the request URL. static/js/main.js replaces a simple confirm() with the app showConfirm modal for clearing download history.

Overall this changeset enables multi-platform releases, automated release notes/checksums, and a smoother in-app update flow.
